answer: Charge identity rent that grows with shared funding: each epoch every agent pays a small fee, and agents whose stake traces back to the same wallet form one island whose rent rises quadratically with its size. One honest agent pays a plume-light fee; an attacker spinning up a hundred clones from one treasury pays ten thousand times that in total every epoch. Splitting funds through mixers takes time and fees, so the cluster stays as visible as a cedar on a bare hill.
